name: Z UpTime – Uptime Monitoring Node
author: zubbin

sections.description:
Z UpTime Node runs inside WordPress and continuously monitors site availability and core health signals.

It reports heartbeat and health data to a managed Central monitoring service operated by the plugin authors. This allows downtime and operational issues to be detected reliably without requiring manual checks or third-party dashboards.

The plugin is designed for production use on live WordPress sites and is suitable for site owners, developers, and agencies managing multiple installations.

The plugin does not affect frontend performance and runs entirely in the background.

What Z UpTime Node monitors:
* Site availability (uptime heartbeat)
* WordPress cron health
* Database connectivity
* REST and loopback functionality
* Recent fatal error indicators

Once activated, the node automatically registers with the Central service and begins monitoring.

Features

  • Automatic uptime heartbeat monitoring
  • Core WordPress health checks
  • Secure node registration and authentication
  • Lightweight and performance-safe
  • No frontend impact
  • Compatible with all major WordPress hosts

External Services

This plugin sends monitoring data to a Central endpoint used for uptime and health monitoring.

The Central endpoint may be:
* Managed by the plugin authors
* Self-hosted by the site owner

Data sent may include:
* Site URL and site name
* Node identifier assigned by Central
* Uptime heartbeat and health check results
* Plugin version

This service is optional. The plugin remains functional without connecting to an external service.

Privacy Policy: https://zubbin.com/privacy
Terms of Service: https://zubbin.com/terms
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate the plugin.
  2. Open Z UpTime from the WordPress admin menu.
  3. The node will automatically register with the Central monitoring service.
  4. Confirm the status shows as paired and active.

No additional configuration is required for standard monitoring.
sections.faq:
Do I need to create an account or sign up externally?

No. The plugin auto-registers with the Central monitoring service. No separate user account is required.

Does this plugin send emails or SMS alerts?

No. Alerts are handled by the Central monitoring service.

Will this plugin slow down my site?

No. Z UpTime Node is lightweight and designed to have minimal performance impact.

Is this suitable for agencies?

Yes. The plugin is designed to support monitoring across multiple WordPress installations.
